en.title: Case Converter — Coding.Tools
en.description: Convert text to uppercase, lowercase, sentence case, title case, or invert case instantly.
en.toolDescription: Transform text between uppercase, lowercase, sentence case, title case, and inverted case.
en.inputPlaceholder: Enter or paste text to convert...
descParas: This case converter transforms text between five common capitalization styles: upper case, lower case, sentence case, title case, and inverted case. It is useful when you need to reformat text for headlines, documents, code comments, or any situation where consistent casing matters.
The conversion runs locally in your browser. The text you paste into the editor is not uploaded, stored, or sent to a server, so you can use the tool for quick checks without changing your workflow.
steps: Paste or type your text into the input editor.
Click one of the five conversion buttons: UPPER CASE, lower case, Sentence case, Title Case, or Invert Case.
The text in the editor is converted in place. Use Copy for the clipboard, Download for a text file, or Clear to reset the editor.
en.whatIs: What are the different case styles?
whatIsParas: UPPER CASE converts every letter to its uppercase form. lower case converts every letter to its lowercase form. Sentence case capitalizes the first letter of each sentence and lowercases the rest. Title Case capitalizes the first letter of every word. Invert Case swaps the case of every character, turning upper into lower and vice versa.
en.inputNotesPara: The tool works with any text, including Unicode characters. Sentence case uses periods, exclamation marks, and question marks as sentence boundaries. Title case capitalizes every word without exceptions for articles or prepositions.
en.examplePara: See how the same sentence looks in each case style:
en.exampleCode:
--- Original ---
hello world! this is a test.

--- UPPER CASE ---
HELLO WORLD! THIS IS A TEST.

--- lower case ---
hello world! this is a test.

--- Sentence case ---
Hello world! This is a test.

--- Title Case ---
Hello World! This Is A Test.

--- Invert Case ---
HELLO WORLD! THIS IS A TEST.

cn.title: 大小写转换 — Coding.Tools
cn.description: 即时将文本转换为大写、小写、句首大写、标题大写或反转大小写。
cn.toolDescription: 在大写、小写、句首大写、标题大写和反转大小写之间转换文本。
cn.inputPlaceholder: 输入或粘贴要转换的文本...
descParas: 这个大小写转换工具可以在五种常见的大小写样式之间转换文本：大写、小写、句首大写、标题大写和反转大小写。
转换在浏览器中本地运行。您粘贴到编辑器中的文本不会被上传、存储或发送到服务器。
steps: 在输入编辑器中粘贴或输入文本。
点击五个转换按钮之一：大写、小写、句首大写、标题大写或反转大小写。
编辑器中的文本会被原地转换。使用复制复制到剪贴板，下载保存为文本文件，或清除重置编辑器。
cn.whatIs: 不同的大小写样式是什么？
whatIsParas: 大写将每个字母转换为大写形式。小写将每个字母转换为小写形式。句首大写将每个句子的首字母大写。标题大写将每个单词的首字母大写。反转大小写交换每个字符的大小写。
cn.inputNotesPara: 该工具适用于任何文本，包括 Unicode 字符。句首大写使用句号、感叹号和问号作为句子边界。标题大写对每个单词首字母大写，不考虑冠词或介词。
cn.examplePara: 查看同一句子在各种大小写样式中的效果：
cn.exampleCode:
--- Original ---
hello world! this is a test.

--- UPPER CASE ---
HELLO WORLD! THIS IS A TEST.

--- lower case ---
hello world! this is a test.

--- Sentence case ---
Hello world! This is a test.

--- Title Case ---
Hello World! This Is A Test.

--- Invert Case ---
HELLO WORLD! THIS IS A TEST.

descParas: 這個大小寫轉換工具可以在五種常見的大小寫樣式之間轉換文字。

點擊五個轉換按鈕之一。
編輯器中的文字會被原地轉換。使用複製複製到剪貼簿，下載儲存為文字檔案，或清除重設編輯器。

tw.examplePara: 查看同一句子在各種大小寫樣式中的效果：

Hello world! This is a test.

--- Title Case ---
Hello World! This Is A Test.

--- Invert Case ---

jp.title: 大文字小文字変換 — Coding.Tools
